description: Claude Code wording that must not be in an installed command, from part 1 of the command adaptation map. The lint runs on the final text of every command that is about to be installed (the file with its frontmatter, header and body). A hit stops the plan, so no command with Claude-only constructs is ever installed. Credit and license lines are not checked: they are ECC's words and are never rewritten. A pattern has an id, a regular expression (`pattern`, with optional `flags` from i, m, s and u), a `why`, and optionally `in`: `frontmatter` to check only the frontmatter. The placeholder {{commands}} stands for the names of the ECC commands that get the ecc- prefix, {{uninstalledSkills}} for the skills ECC names that are not installed.
